items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Dexter was on the band, Red Calendar, myself.

ctx.x: Red Calendar. What was it you were playing? You mentioned Dexter Gordon.
Yeah, Dexter was on the band, Red Calendar, myself. The guy who had the band was a drummer, and he couldn't drum very well, but he had the gig, you know. It was his job.
